The '''antimissile octet''' was a fast firing, fast tracking [[Missile/Legends|missile]]-interception projectile weapon. Upon activation it would establish a firing solution on any incoming missiles and then begin firing into its projected path. It would fill that path with a large amount of metal shrapnel with the intention of detonating the missile before it reached its target. These weapon systems were deployed on some of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[New Class Modernization Program]] designs, most notably the [[Majestic-class heavy cruiser|''Majestic''-class heavy cruiser]] and [[Warrior-class gunship|''Warrior''-class gunship]], and were used during the [[Battle of ILC-905]].<ref name="Tyrant's Test">''[[Tyrant's Test]]</ref>
